title: PRD section 3 complete first-run journey manifest
authority: developer-owned advisory measurement infrastructure. The manifest declaratively describes how an external WebDriver lane drives the whole journey; the journey verdict itself belongs to the host collector, never to the developer.

isolation.rule: The driver launches the app with FOCUSBOARD_DATA_DIR pointing at one fresh, empty per-run directory. All state (SQLite store, mail sink, sessions) lives inside it, so the run cannot observe or mutate any normal user profile.
isolation.default_startup_behavior: none. The app creates no account, session, or data mutation on startup; every driven action is an explicit step below.
opt_in_gates_preserved: hidden non-focusable #golden-path-trigger button (tabIndex=-1, aria-hidden) is the only drive starter
backend drive steps refuse with drive_not_started until golden_path_drive_start ran explicitly
reminder-email probe returns booleans only, never message content

action_link_retrieval.opt_in_contract: Opt-in by launching the app with FOCUSBOARD_DATA_DIR set to a fresh per-run directory. There is no default-startup mail export, no network delivery, and no normal-profile contact; the sink exists only inside the isolated profile and is written by the product's normal send path.

record_format.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, one object per message file; outbox.jsonl is one JSON object per line in delivery order

host_lane_dependencies: Registering a manifest-consuming journey stage in the host focusboard-native-webdriver scenario (Host follow-up; outside developer write targets).

Out-of-process focusboard:// link activation (OS handler / mail client): structurally unavailable in this harness; waived for the external-activation receipt lane. The in-app paste affordance (steps follow_verification_link, reset_open_link) keeps these steps drivable without it.

expected_state.description: Auth shell renders the sign-in panel with heading 'Sign in with email'.
expected_state.observable: h1#signin-title text equals 'Sign in with email'

steps.title: Submit a valid email and password

expected_state.description: Registration accepted; app shows the check-your-email panel.

steps.title: Retrieve the verification email action link

expected_state.description: Exactly the action_link_retrieval record exists whose to matches {email} and whose action_url matches the verification pattern; its token is extracted for the next step.

steps.notes: Pure filesystem read of the isolated profile; no IPC, no DOM probe, no default-startup behavior.

steps.title: Follow the verification link and return to the application

expected_state.description: Verification accepted; the app returns to the sign-in panel.
expected_state.observable: h1#signin-title visible with a success notice in .auth-notice[role=status]

steps.notes: Driven through the real paste-link affordance. Out-of-process focusboard:// activation is host-lane-dependent and waived (see host_lane_dependencies).

steps.title: Sign in and remain signed in after a page refresh

expected_state.description: Signed in; after a webview reload the session restores to the Today surface with the six primary nav items.
expected_state.observable: [data-testid=nav-today] exists and .view-head h1 equals 'Today' after reload

steps.title: Create a project named 'Launch plan' with a restrained accent

expected_state.description: Project board lists the new project with one of the product's restrained palette accents.

steps.title: Create the task, assign it, set due date, reminder time and timezone

expected_state.description: Task row carries the project assignment, due date, and a scheduled reminder.

steps.title: Confirm the task appears in Inbox, Today, Projects, and the Calendar date

expected_state.description: Inbox lists the task; Today lists it under its due date; the Projects board shows it in the project column; the Calendar agenda/grid shows it on {due_date}.
expected_state.observable: [data-testid=task-row] with title {task_title} present in each of the four views

steps.title: Start a focus session, pause, resume, and complete the task

expected_state.description: Session reaches running, paused, running again, then completed.
expected_state.observable: [data-testid=focus-active] data-focus-state passes running -> paused -> running -> completed

steps.title: Confirm the task is completed exactly once and the daily summary updates

expected_state.description: Exactly one completed row for the task; the Today daily summary reflects one completed focus session for the day.

steps.title: Confirm the reminder email with task title, due context, and safe task link

expected_state.description: A reminder record exists addressed to {email} whose subject contains the task title, whose body carries the due context, and whose action_url matches focusboard://task?id= with no token.
expected_state.observable: one reminder record matching all three content predicates

steps.notes: The reminder is triggered at its scheduled instant by the app's reminder tick; the scheduled time template {reminder_time} resolves to the current minute so delivery happens during the run.

steps.title: Log out, sign back in, confirm task and completion state persist

expected_state.description: After sign-out the auth shell renders; after signing back in, Today still lists the completed task.
expected_state.observable: h1#signin-title after sign-out, then [data-testid=task-row][data-status=completed] after sign-in

steps.title: Request a password reset from the sign-in panel

expected_state.description: Forgot-password panel accepts the email; a check-your-email confirmation renders.

steps.title: Retrieve the reset email action link

expected_state.description: A reset record exists for {email} whose action_url matches the reset pattern; its token is extracted.

steps.title: Open the reset link and set a new password

expected_state.description: The reset link opens the set-new-password panel; submitting updates the password.
expected_state.observable: h1#reset-form-title 'Set a new password', then h1#reset-done-title 'Password updated'

steps.notes: The app routes an activation link delivered in the webview URL hash (any '#...reset?token=...' hash) to the reset surface, so the driver follows the link by navigating the webview URL — a real navigation, not a DOM probe. Out-of-process focusboard:// activation stays host-lane-dependent and waived.

steps.title: Sign in with the new password

expected_state.description: The new password signs in; the app shell renders.

steps.title: An expired or already-used reset link lands in an honest recovery state

expected_state.description: A spent or expired reset token renders the invalid/expired panel, and the recovery affordance requests a fresh link back to the check-your-email state.
expected_state.observable: h1#reset-title matches 'isn't valid|expired|already used', then clicking 'Request a fresh link' returns to the forgot-sent state

steps.notes: Expired-token fixture: reuse the token consumed by reset_open_link, or request a reset and let the 60-minute expiry lapse in a seeded store. Reuse of a single-use token is the drivable equivalent.
